question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me list the staff and customers who have email addresses ending in .org, and show how many complaints each of them is linked to? I'd love to see their IDs, names (or email), and the complaint counts.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The filter 'who have email addresses ending in .org' applies only to the customers; all staff are included regardless of their email domain.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s.staff_id AS id,
       s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS name,
       COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
FROM Staff s
LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
UNION ALL
SELECT cu.customer_id AS id,
       cu.email_address AS name,
       COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
FROM Customers cu
LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE cu.email_address LIKE '%.org'
GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.email_address;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The filter 'who have email addresses ending in .org' applies to both staff and customers, so only those staff and those customers whose email addresses end in .org should be listed.

       COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
FROM Staff s
LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE s.email_address LIKE '%.org'
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

UNION ALL

SELECT cu.customer_id AS id,
       cu.email_address AS name,
       COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count
FROM Customers cu
LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE cu.email_address LIKE '%.org'
GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.email_address;

       entity_type

    SELECT s.staff_id AS id,

           COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_count,
           'Staff' AS entity_type
    FROM Staff s
    LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
    WHERE s.email_address LIKE '%.org'
    GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
    UNION ALL
